responsibility: Implements code generation for Rust intrinsics callable from MIR, translating supported intrinsic instances into backend operations such as memory ops, atomics, pointer metadata queries, and other builtins, while delegating unsupported cases to backend-specific intrinsic handling or fallback instances.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `traits/intrinsic.rs`, which only declares backend intrinsic operations, this file contains the MIR lowering logic that recognizes many Rust intrinsics itself, performs generic SSA-side translation for them, and delegates only backend-specific or unsupported cases.
